source: Curated skill combinations — job → skill-set. Seed set; grow over time.
note: REFERENCE, not triggers. job→skill-set. Offer a combo ONLY if the user actually has these skills (check {INDEX}); decide fit by reasoning about the task, never by matching a stored condition. Native silently picks one skill and never assembles combos — these are yours to surface as a pick-menu.

combos.job_en: Research a topic with cited sources, then turn it into a presentation
combos.benefit_en: From question to slides in one pass, sources carried through.
combos.benefit_zh: 从问题到成稿一气呵成，引用不丢。

combos.job_en: Author a formatted document, then export / sign / merge it as PDF
combos.benefit_en: Write and ship the final PDF without leaving the chat.
combos.benefit_zh: 写完直接出可交付的 PDF。

combos.job_en: Analyze a spreadsheet, then write the findings up as a document
combos.benefit_en: Numbers and narrative produced together, one consistent story.
combos.benefit_zh: 数据与结论一并产出，口径一致。

combos.job_en: Build a UI, then verify it actually works in a browser before trusting it
combos.benefit_en: Design and proof-it-works in one loop, not two separate asks.
combos.benefit_zh: 设计与验证一个回合完成。

combos.job_en: Review a contract for risk AND check the cross-border compliance gaps it creates
combos.benefit_en: Risk + regulatory in one pass, not two disconnected asks.
combos.benefit_zh: 风险与合规一次过，不脱节。
